  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR CAPITAL PARTNERS, LLC</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR SECURED LENDING PARTNERS, LLC</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Appendix A: Joint Code of Ethics and Insider Trading Policy</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:6.667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">I.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">INTRODUCTION</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital Partners, LLC and SLR Secured Lending Partners, LLC (each an &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Adviser</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; and together, the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Advisers</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) seek to foster and maintain a reputation for honesty, integrity and professionalism.  That reputation is a vital business asset.  The confidence and trust placed in the Advisers are highly valued and must be protected.  The Advisers have adopted this Code of Ethics (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Code</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) in accordance with Rules 204A-1 under the Advisers Act and Rule 17j-l under the Investment Company Act.  The Code includes the Advisers&#x2019; policy with respect to personal investment and trading and its insider trading policy and procedures.  SLR Investment Corp., SCP Private Credit Income BDC LLC, SLR HC BDC LLC, SLR Private Credit BDC II LLC and SLR Secured Specialty Lending Fund (collectively referred to as, the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">BDC</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">or the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Company</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;)</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">have similarly and jointly adopted this Code of Ethics.  Thus, this Code of Ethics is applicable to all Access Persons (as defined below) of the Advisers and the Company (collectively &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;).</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:6.667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">II.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">DEFINITIONS</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">A.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Access Person.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Access Person</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means (i) any Supervised Person who (1) has access to nonpublic information regarding a Client&#x2019;s purchase or sale of securities; (2) has access to nonpublic information regarding the portfolio holdings of any Reportable Fund; and/or (3) is involved in making securities recommendations to Clients or who has access to such recommendations that are nonpublic and (ii) all of the directors (other than disinterested directors), officers, employees, members or partners of SLR Capital that are not included in (i) of this paragraph.  By way of example, Access Persons include portfolio management personnel and service representatives who communicate investment advice to Clients.  </font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">B.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Advisers Act.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Advisers Act</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">C.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Automatic Investment Plan.  An &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Automatic Investment Plan</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; is a program in which regular periodic purchases or withdrawals are made automatically in or from investment accounts according to a predetermined schedule and allocation.  An Automatic Investment Plan includes a dividend reinvestment plan.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">D.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Beneficial Ownership Interest.  You will be considered to have &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Beneficial Ownership Interest</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; in a Security if you have a Pecuniary Interest in the Security. If you have any question about whether an interest in a Security or an account constitutes Beneficial Ownership of that Security, you should contact the Chief Compliance Officer.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">E.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Chief Compliance Officer.  The &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Chief Compliance Officer</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; is the Access Person designated respectively by Adviser and BDC for each entity respectively as such, as identified in SLR Capital&#x2019;s Compliance Policies and Procedures Manual.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">F.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Client.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Client</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any investment entity or account advised or managed or sub-advised by Adviser, including any pooled investment vehicle advised or sub&#x2011;advised by Adviser.</font></div></div></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;"></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">G.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Commission.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Commission</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the United States Securities and Exchange Commission.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">H.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Compliance Officer.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Compliance Officer</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">shall mean an Access Person deemed by SLR Capital to be sufficiently experienced to perform senior-level compliance functions, and shall include the Chief Compliance Officer.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">I.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Disinterested Director.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Disinterested Director</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">means a director of the Company who is not an &#x201c;interested person&#x201d; of the Company within the meaning of Section 2(a)(19) of the Investment Company Act.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">J.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Exchange Act.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Exchange Act</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">K.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Federal Securities Laws.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Federal Securities Laws</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Securities Act, the Exchange Act, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, the Investment Company Act, the Advisers Act, Title V of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, any rules adopted by the Commission under any of these statutes, the Bank Secrecy Act as it applies to funds and investment advisers, and any rules adopted under the Bank Secrecy Act by the Commission or the Department of the Treasury.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">L.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Fund.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Fund</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any pooled investment vehicle, whether registered, required to be registered, or exempt from registration as an &#x201c;investment company&#x201d; pursuant to the Investment Company Act.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">M.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Immediate Family.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Immediate Family</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; includes a Supervised Person&#x2019;s child, stepchild, grandchild, parent, stepparent, grandparent, spouse, sibling, mother&#x2011;in&#x2011;law, father-in-law, son-in-law, daughter-in-law, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law, and includes any adoptive relationship.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">N.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Broad-Based Securities.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Broad-Based Securities</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means interests in exchange&#x2011;traded funds or derivatives based on broad-based market indices, sectors, or industries. This term does not include custom exchange-traded funds or exchange-traded funds based on less than 5 companies.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">O.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Initial Public Offering.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Initial Public Offering</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means an offering of securities registered under the Securities Act, the issuer of which, immediately before the registration, was not subject to the reporting requirements of Sections 13 or 15(d) of the Exchange Act.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">P.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Investment Company Act.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Investment Company Act</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">Q.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Limited Offering.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Limited Offering</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means an offering, typically referred to as a &#x201c;private placement&#x201d;, that is exempt from registration under the Securities Act.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">R.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Non-Reportable Securities.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Non-Reportable Securities</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means:  (i) direct obligations of the U.S. Government; (ii) bankers&#x2019; acceptances, bank certificates of deposit, commercial paper and high quality short-term debt instruments (defined as any instrument that has a maturity at issuance of less than 366 days and that is rated in one of the two highest rating categories by a Nationally Recognized Statistical Rating Organization), including repurchase agreements; (iii) shares issued by money market funds; (iv) shares issued by open&#x2011;end funds registered under the Investment Company Act, other than Reportable Funds; and (v) shares issued by unit investment trusts that are invested exclusively in one or more open end funds, none of which are Reportable Funds.</font></div></div></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;"></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">S.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Partners.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Partners</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; refers to Michael Gross and Bruce Spohler.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">T.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pecuniary Interest.  You will be considered to have a &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pecuniary Interest</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; in a Security if you, directly or indirectly, through any contract, arrangement, understanding, relationship or otherwise, have the opportunity, directly or indirectly, to profit or share in any profit derived from a transaction in the Security.  The term &#x201c;Pecuniary Interest&#x201d; is construed very broadly.  The following examples illustrate this principle:  (i) ordinarily, you will be deemed to have a &#x201c;Pecuniary Interest&#x201d; in all Securities owned by members of your Immediate Family who share the same household with you; (ii) if you are a general partner of a general or limited partnership, you will be deemed to have a &#x201c;Pecuniary Interest&#x201d; in all Securities held by the partnership; (iii) if you are a shareholder of a corporation or similar business entity, you will be deemed to have a &#x201c;Pecuniary Interest&#x201d; in all Securities held by the corporation if you are a controlling shareholder or have or share investment control over the corporation&#x2019;s investment portfolio; (iv) if you have the right to acquire equity Securities through the exercise or conversion of a derivative Security, you will be deemed to have a Pecuniary Interest in the Securities, whether or not your right is presently exercisable; (v) if you are the sole member or a manager of a limited liability company, you will be deemed to have a Pecuniary Interest in the Securities held by the limited liability company; and (vi) ordinarily, if you are a trustee or beneficiary of a trust, where either you or members of your Immediate Family have a vested interest in the principal or income of the trust, you will be deemed to have a Pecuniary Interest in all Securities held by that trust.  If you have any questions about whether an interest in a Security or an account constitutes a Pecuniary Interest, you should contact the Chief Compliance Officer.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">U.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reportable Fund.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reportable Fund</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means (i) any Fund for which Adviser serves as investment adviser; or (ii) any Fund whose investment adviser or principal underwriter controls Adviser, is controlled by Adviser, or is under common control with Adviser.  As used in this definition, the term </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">control </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">has the same meaning as it does in Section 2(a)(9) of the Investment Company Act.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">V.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reportable Security.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reportable Security</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means all Securities other than Non-Reportable Securities.  Reportable Securities include Broad-Based Securities, municipal securities and any other securities not specifically included in the definition of a Non-Reportable Security.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">W.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Restricted List.  The &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Restricted List</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; is a list maintained by the Chief Compliance Officer as specified by SLR Capital&#x2019;s </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Insider Trading Policies and Procedures</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">X.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SEC.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SEC</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">Y.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Securities Act.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Securities Act</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">Z.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Security.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Security</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; has the same meaning as it has in section 202(a)(18) of the Advisers Act.  For purposes of this Code, the following are Securities:</font></div></div><p style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-right:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any note, stock, treasury stock, security future, bond, debenture, evidence of indebtedness, certificate of interest or participation in any profit-sharing agreement, collateral-trust certificate, preorganization certificate or subscription, transferable share, investment contract, voting-trust certificate, certificate of deposit for a security, fractional undivided interest in oil, gas, or other mineral rights, any put, call, straddle, option or privilege on any security (including a certificate of deposit) or on any group or index of securities (including any interest therein or based on the value thereof), or any put, call, straddle, option or privilege entered into on a national securities exchange relating to foreign currency, or, in general, any interest or instrument commonly known as a security, or any certificate of interest or participation in, temporary or interim certificate for, receipt for, guarantee of, or warrant or right to subscribe to or purchase, any security.</font></p></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;"></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The following are </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">not </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Securities:</font></p><p style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-right:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Commodities, futures and options traded on a commodities exchange, including currency futures, except that (i) options on any group or index of Securities and (ii) futures on any group or narrow-based index of Securities are Securities.</font></p><p style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-right:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">You should note that &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Security</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; includes a right to acquire a Security, as well as an interest in a collective investment vehicle (such as a limited partnership or limited liability company).</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">AA.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Supervised Person.  The term &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Supervised Person</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means (i) any partner, member, officer or director of SLR Capital, or other person occupying a similar status or performing similar function; (ii) any employee of SLR Capital; (iii) any U.S. consultant who has been contracted by SLR Capital for more than ninety (90) days; and (iv) any other person who provides advice on behalf of SLR Capital and is subject to SLR Capital&#x2019;s supervision and control.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:6.667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">III.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">ANTI-BRIBERY REQUIREMENTS</font></div></div><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Advisers are committed to complying with the laws and regulations designed to combat bribery and corruption (herein after referred to as &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">anti-bribery</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) and to seeking and retaining business on the basis of merit, not through bribery or corruption.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">It is the Advisers&#x2019; policy that:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.571084182443509%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Personnel may not provide anything of value to obtain or retain business or favored treatment from public officials; candidates for office; employees of state-owned enterprises; clients/customers, or suppliers; any agent of the aforementioned parties; or any other person with whom the Adviser does or anticipates doing business.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.571084182443509%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The prohibition against providing &#x201c;anything of value&#x201d; to obtain or retain business or favored treatment includes obvious improper payments, such as cash bribes or kickbacks, but also may include other direct or indirect benefits and advantages, such as gifts, meals, entertainment, charitable contributions, and offers of employment or internships that are inappropriate.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.571084182443509%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The prohibition extends not only to public officials, but also to corporate clients and other private parties.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:6.667%;tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:3.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.571084182443509%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Advisers prohibit its personnel from requesting or accepting bribes and other improper financial advantages, as well as offering them.</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Advisers maintain written policies, procedures and internal controls reasonably designed to comply with anti-bribery laws (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Anti-Bribery Program</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;).  The Anti-Bribery Program includes a risk assessment process, education and training, review and approval processes, due diligence procedures, accounting processes and independent testing processes.  The Advisers expect all of its agents and vendors to (i) maintain policies and procedures applicable to their circumstances and proportionate to the risks they face and (ii) to act at all times in a manner consistent with the Advisers&#x2019; anti-bribery policies.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Personnel who engage in or facilitate bribery, or who fail to comply with all applicable anti-bribery laws, regulations, and the Adviser&#x2019;s anti-bribery and related policies, may be subject to disciplinary action.  The Advisers reserve the right to terminate immediately any business relationship that violates the Advisers&#x2019; anti-bribery policies.</font></p></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;"></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Advisers will conduct targeted email reviews, discussion of the policy will be conducted in code of ethics training.  Any exceptions to the policy will be reported to Management.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:6.667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">IV.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">PERSONAL INVESTMENT AND TRADING POLICY</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">A.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">General Statement</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital is committed to maintaining the highest standard of business conduct.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital and its Supervised Persons must not act or behave in any manner or engage in any activity that (1) involves or creates even the suspicion or appearance of the misuse of material, nonpublic information by SLR Capital or any Supervised Person or (2) gives rise to, or appears to give rise to, any breach of fiduciary duty owed to any Client or investor.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In addition, the Federal Securities Laws require that investment advisers maintain a record of every transaction in any Security, with certain exceptions, as described below, in which any Access Person acquires or disposes of Beneficial Ownership where the Security is or was held in an account over which the Access Person has direct or indirect influence or control.  Given the current size of its operations, </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital has chosen to require reporting of transactions, as well as pre-approval of certain transactions, for all Supervised Persons (subject to the specific exceptions in the Code), rather than only Access Persons.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, Disinterested Directors are not subject to the preclearance and reporting requirements of the Code.  However, with respect to the Company&#x2019;s securities Disinterested Directors must transact during the window periods as described in Appendix VII of this </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Code of Ethics</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and subsequently report the transaction detail to the Company on the day of the transaction.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital has developed the following policies and procedures relating to personal trading in Securities and the reporting of such personal trading in Securities in order to ensure that each Supervised Person satisfies the requirements of this Code.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">B.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Requirements of this Code</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Duty to Comply with Applicable Laws.</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">All Supervised Persons are required to comply with the Federal Securities Laws, the fiduciary duty owed by the Advisers to their Clients, as applicable, and this Code.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">2.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Insider Trading Controls</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">All Supervised Persons are required to comply with the </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Insider Trading Policies and Procedures </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">adopted by the Advisers and the BDC which appears as </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Appendix VII </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">of this Code of Ethics and is incorporated herein by this reference.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Duty to Report Violations.</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Each Supervised Person is required by law to promptly notify the Chief Compliance Officer or designee in the event he or she knows or has reason to believe that he or she or any other Supervised Person has violated any provision of this Code.  If a Supervised Person knows or has reason to believe that the Chief Compliance Officer has violated any provision of this Code, the Supervised Person must promptly notify the Chief Financial Officer and is not required to notify the Chief Compliance Officer.</font></p></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;"></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital is committed to fostering a culture of compliance.  SLR Capital therefore urges you to contact the Chief Compliance Officer or designee if you have any questions regarding compliance.  You will not be penalized and your status at SLR Capital will not be jeopardized by communicating with the Chief Compliance Officer.  Reports of violations or a suspected violation also may be submitted anonymously to the Chief Compliance Officer or designee.  Any retaliatory action taken against any person who in good faith reports a violation or a suspected violation of this Code is itself a violation of this Code and cause for appropriate corrective action, including dismissal.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">4.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Supervised Personnel to be Supplied Copies, and Furnish Acknowledgements of Receipt of the Code of Ethics and Any Amendments Thereof.</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Capital will provide all Supervised Persons with a copy of this Code and all subsequent amendments.  By law, all Supervised Persons must in turn provide written acknowledgement to the Chief Compliance Officer or designee of their initial receipt and review of this Code, their annual review of this Code and their receipt and review of any subsequent amendments to this Code.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:6.667%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;justify-content:flex-start;min-width:2.4%;">C.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Restrictions on Supervised Persons Trading in Securities</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Generally.  </font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Purchases of Reportable Securities (other than Broad-Based Securities) by Supervised Persons and participation by Supervised Persons in an Initial Public Offering or Limited Offering require advance preclearance approval, in writing, by a Compliance Officer together with the </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">specific approval</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of both Partners.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Sales of Reportable Securities (other than Broad-Based Securities) by Supervised Persons require advance preclearance approval, in writing, by a Compliance Officer together with the </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">specific approval</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of both Partners.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">All Supervised Person personal trading in Securities (other than Broad-Based Securities) is subject to the following further requirements and/or restrictions.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any transaction in a Security subject to the Restricted List of issuers maintained by SLR Capital is strictly prohibited.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any transaction in a Security which the Supervised Person knows or has reason to know is being purchased or sold, or is being considered for purchase or sale, by or on behalf of a Client is prohibited until the Client&#x2019;s transaction has been completed or consideration of the transaction is abandoned.  A Security is &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">being considered for purchase or sale</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; the earlier of (i) when a recommendation to purchase or sell has been made and communicated or (ii) the Security is placed on Adviser&#x2019;s research project lists or, (iii) with respect to the Supervised Person making the recommendation, when the Supervised Person seriously considers making such a recommendation.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">No Supervised Person may engage in a transaction in a Security, which includes an interest in a Fund, if the Supervised Person&#x2019;s transaction would otherwise disadvantage or appear to disadvantage a Client or if the Supervised Person would inappropriately profit from or appear to so profit from the transaction, whether or not at the expense of the Client.  </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the avoidance of doubt, this prohibition applies to any Security held, at the time of a personal transaction, in any Client account</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any transaction in a Security during the period which begins three days before and ends three days after any Client has traded in that Security is prohibited, unless approved by a Compliance </font></div></div></div>
  <div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;"></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;"></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Officer.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(e)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">No matched purchases and sales, or sales and purchases, in the same Security within a thirty-day period may be transacted without the advance approval of a Compliance Officer. This is requirement is reviewed on a &#x201c;first-in, first-out&#x201d; basis. This means that a security that is already in someone&#x2019;s portfolio may be sold within thirty-days of a purchase if certain shares of that security were in the portfolio prior to the thirty-day period.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:13.333%;tab-size:32px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:13.333%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.8%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(f)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Personal account trading must be done on the Supervised Person&#x2019;s own time without placing undue burden on SLR Capital&#x2019;s time.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper"
